name: Hiroba Mahiru
source:
Our protagonist. An average, very feminine girl, though it was revealed she was born as a boy.

Mahiru is very bright, cheerful and very expressive with her emotions. She tends to laugh off her worries quite easily. She tries not to think about what happened to her, and still live as a girl.

Despite all this, she's worried about her frail-looking body.

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20031016091752/http://www.active-soft.jp/catalog/negaposi.html]official website[/url]]
